parsed.change_summary: Added a check to ensure that term->osc_strlen is greater than 1 before calling base64_decode_block. This prevents a buffer over-read if term->osc_string is manipulated to be too short.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now checks if term->osc_strlen is greater than 1 before passing term->osc_string+1 to base64_decode_block. If term->osc_strlen is 1 or less, the function breaks out of the block without calling base64_decode_block, thus preventing any potential buffer over-read.
